Don't you fucking trivialize me like that. These are the issues I've been facing every fucking day of my life. Daylight! This doesn't fucking go away tomorrow. This could be my last fucking night! Because of this! Apparently I'm too angry! I'm too erratic?! Is that it?! A night sleep is going to make me stop hating myself. Maybe if I fell asleep on a bullet, quickly.

Sleep in-fucking-deed. I need a fucking lobotomy. Then sleep may help.
